This is a low-magnitude "function word" neuron: it fires mildly on connective/preposition tokens mid-sentence ("and", "than", "of", "with", opening curly quote) and is most strongly (negatively) driven by the complement prepositions "to"/"with" that follow similarity/comparison words (identical to, similar to, harmonious with, intertwined with).

This neuron is mainly a suppression unit: it goes strongly negative on tokens that are copied/predicted from an earlier occurrence in the same passage (induction-style repeats like the second "contact us for quote", repeated "PHA", an acronym being spelled out after "stands for", a surname repeated), while its weak positive side is unspecific, firing on ordinary mid-sentence function/filler words ("rest", "that", "no", "is", "choose").
